_note: Official vendor list rates only, hand-verified against the vendor own pricing/docs pages on 2026-09-12 (see docs/research/capybench/{research-brief.md,sources.json}). Never a reseller, never an aggregator. Rates are USD per million tokens, standard tier: non-batch, non-cached, short/standard context. Tiered rates live in `tiers` and are never folded into the main rate. A null rate is UNVERIFIED and run.mjs refuses to run that model. maxOutputTokens here is the MODEL cap; the run protocol clamps every run to 64000 (see docs/research/capybench/implementation-plan.md §3). Keys starting with _ are ignored.

claude-fable-5-1.label: Claude Fable 5.1
claude-fable-5-1.tiers: Batch API 50% off ($5 in / $25 out). Cache write 5m $12.50/MTok (1.25x input), 1h $20/MTok (2x). Cache read $0.25/MTok (0.025x input — the 5.1 line only; all other Claude models read at 0.1x). 1M-token context at the standard per-token rate, no long-context surcharge. Retirement: no sooner than 2027-09-01.

claude-opus-5.label: Claude Opus 5
claude-opus-5.tiers: Batch API 50% off ($2.50 in / $12.50 out). Cache write 5m $6.25/MTok, 1h $10/MTok. Cache read $0.50/MTok (0.1x). 1M-token context, no surcharge. Fast mode (research preview): $10 in / $50 out. Retirement: 2027-07-24.

claude-sonnet-5.label: Claude Sonnet 5
claude-sonnet-5.tiers: Batch API 50% off ($1 in / $5 out). Cache write 5m $2.50/MTok, 1h $4/MTok. Cache read $0.20/MTok (0.1x). 1M-token context, no surcharge. A planned 2026-09-01 increase to $3/$15 was cancelled per the pricing page. Retirement: 2027-06-30.

claude-haiku-4-5.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
claude-haiku-4-5.tiers: Dated snapshot ID: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Batch API 50% off ($0.50 in / $2.50 out). Cache write 5m $1.25/MTok, 1h $2/MTok. Cache read $0.10/MTok (0.1x). 200K context. Retirement: 2026-10-15 on Anthropic-operated platforms — re-verify before any run after that date.

gpt-6-astra.label: GPT-6 Astra
gpt-6-astra.tiers: Cached input $1.00/MTok (0.1x); cache write $12.50/MTok (1.25x), 30-min TTL, automatic at >=1,024 prompt tokens. Long context (>272K tokens): $20 in / $75 out. Batch API 50% off ($5/$25 short-ctx). Fast mode ~2x standard. Context window 1.05M.

gpt-5.6-sol.label: GPT-5.6 Sol
gpt-5.6-sol.tiers: Alias: gpt-5.6. Cached input $0.40/MTok (0.1x); cache write $5.00/MTok (1.25x). Long context (>272K): $8 in / $30 out. Batch 50% off ($2/$10). Promotional pricing in effect 'at least through November 21, 2026' per the pricing page. Context window 1.05M.

gpt-5.6-terra.label: GPT-5.6 Terra
gpt-5.6-terra.tiers: Cached input $0.20/MTok (0.1x); cache write $2.50/MTok (1.25x). Long context (>272K): $4 in / $18 out. Batch 50% off ($1/$6). Context window 1.05M.

gpt-5.6-luna.label: GPT-5.6 Luna
gpt-5.6-luna.tiers: Cached input $0.02/MTok (0.1x); cache write $0.25/MTok (1.25x). Long context (>272K): $0.40 in / $1.80 out. Batch 50% off ($0.10/$0.60). Positioned for cost-sensitive high-volume workloads. Context window 1.05M.

gemini-3.8-flash.label: Gemini 3.8 Flash
gemini-3.8-flash.tiers: Promotional rate through 2026-12-31; $1.50 in / $7.50 out from 2027-01-01. Output price includes thinking tokens. Batch API 50% off ($0.375/$1.875, promo). Priority tier 1.8x ($1.35/$6.75). Explicit context caching: $0.075/MTok read (promo) + storage $0.50/MTok-hr. Implicit caching: automatic, engages on prompts >=4,096 tokens. Free tier available (inputs used to improve Google products — do not use for published runs). Context 1,048,576 in / 65,536 out.
